en.headline: Buildings Department orders investigation of eight more One Stanley houses
en.dek: The developer updated its sales brochure on Friday to disclose a 2 October letter requiring detailed checks and a report within one month on the original villa plus eight others and common areas.
body: The developer of the One Stanley luxury estate in Stanley updated its sales brochure on Friday, disclosing that the Buildings Department had ordered it to investigate eight additional detached houses plus common areas after irregularities were found at one villa.

According to the brochure, the department wrote to the developer on 2 October after inspections and tests at one house. It found that the protective layer of a ground-floor beam lacked the steel-wire mesh shown on approved plans, and that reinforcement in some floor slabs did not match the drawings. The letter requires a detailed investigation and report on the original house, houses numbered 5, 8, 16, 17, 19, 32, 33 and 36, and common areas at Block 9, to be submitted within one month.

The Buildings Department said it was investigating the case seriously and would not comment further at this stage. Four of the eight additional houses have already been sold. Earlier public statements from the department noted that the discrepancies did not pose an obvious danger but required follow-up on workmanship.

zh.headline: 屋宇署要求One Stanley發展商調查額外八座洋房
zh.dek: 發展商周五更新售樓書，披露本月2日接獲署方函件，須就涉事洋房及另外八座洋房連公用地方在一個月內提交詳細調查報告。
body: 赤柱豪宅項目One Stanley發展商建灝地產周五更新售樓書，披露屋宇署本月2日去信，要求就一間獨立屋發現的不合規之處，以及另外八座洋房及公用地方進行詳細調查。
售樓書指，署方人員視察及測試後，發現涉事洋房地面層其中一條橫樑的保護層沒有按批准圖則配置鋼絲網，部分樓板鋼筋配置亦與圖則不符。函件要求發展商就涉事洋房、5、8、16、17、19、32、33及36號洋房，以及第9座公用地方進行調查，並須於函件日期起計一個月內提交結果及相關文件。
屋宇署回應查詢時表示正嚴肅調查個案，現階段不宜進一步評論。需要額外調查的八座洋房中有四座已經出售。署方早前曾指出有關情況未有構成明顯危險，但施工質量須關注及跟進。
